workflow_plan.goal: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College borough boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a candidate polygon boundary for State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the available dataset candidate representing the State College borough boundary. Runtime QC must verify the candidate's spatial coverage, geometry, CRS, and GeoPackage compatibility before downstream use.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject census tracts to DEM CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform census tract geometries into the DEM's known metric CRS so they can be intersected with the borough boundary and used for zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the census tract layer from its observed CRS to EPSG:3857. Preserve tract identity attributes, including GEOID, and preserve valid polygon geometry.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject borough boundary to DEM CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the retrieved borough boundary into the DEM CRS for compatible spatial overlay.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the retrieved borough boundary to EPSG:3857 after confirming its source CRS from runtime metadata. Do not infer or assign a source CRS if it is unknown; route clarification through the blocking CRS requirement.

workflow_steps.title: Select census tracts intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Create polygon zones for the portions of census tracts that intersect the State College borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform an intersection overlay between the reprojected census tracts and the reprojected State College borough boundary. Retain tract identity attributes needed to identify each census tract, including GEOID, and retain valid polygon geometry.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation for intersecting census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute mean elevation from the DEM for each census tract zone intersecting State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute zonal statistics using the DEM raster and the intersecting tract polygon zones, producing a CSV summary with mean elevation for each tract zone. Runtime QC must ground the zone identifier field from the observed intersected-zone schema; do not guess field names.

requirements.scope: The retrieved borough_boundary candidate must represent and cover State College borough.
The retrieved borough boundary must be available as a GeoPackage suitable for vector reprojection.
The reprojected tract output must use EPSG:3857, matching the DEM CRS.
The retrieved borough boundary must have an observed source CRS before reprojection.
The reprojected borough boundary must use EPSG:3857, matching the DEM and reprojected tracts.
Both overlay inputs must use a compatible CRS, specifically EPSG:3857.
The tract and borough geometries must be valid for intersection overlay.
Intersected tract zones must retain a census tract identifier field grounded from the input schema, such as the observed GEOID field.
The DEM raster and polygon zones must use compatible CRSs; the DEM is observed in EPSG:3857 and the planned zones are transformed to EPSG:3857.
The intersecting tract polygon zones must have valid, non-empty geometries for zonal statistics.
The zonal statistics output must retain a tract identifier grounded from the intersected-zone schema.
